title: Do Chinese Investors' Reactions to Merger Announcements Accurately Reflect Prospects for Success?
abstract: Based on his commentary article, Dr. Michael Young will discuss whether investors’ positive reactions to merger announcements in China reliably predict the long-run prospects for merger success. The seminar will consider how event-study evidence should be interpreted, what Chinese stock-market reactions may capture, and how institutional and developmental contexts shape explanations of merger performance.
